title: Sagisag Half Marathon 2026 Manila Review: An SM MOA 21K
seo_title: Sagisag Half Marathon Manila 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: Sagisag Half Marathon 2026 Manila: September 19 at SM Mall of Asia. A 21K, 10K, 5K from RSRJ Events at Manila Bay.
dek: Set for 19 September 2026 at SM Mall of Asia in Pasay, this RSRJ Events half marathon offers three distances at Manila Bay.
verdict: The Sagisag Half Marathon is a RSRJ Events production at SM Mall of Asia — Manila Bay's iconic waterfront venue with a proven flat, fast course. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). RSRJ Events is a named Philippine race organiser. September in Manila is the tail of the wet season. A solid Manila half marathon at a proven venue for runners wanting a straightforward, accessible race experience.

sections.heading: SM MOA: Proven Manila Venue
paragraphs: SM Mall of Asia's flat, waterfront course is one of Metro Manila's most proven race venues. [1] RSRJ Events handles production. September conditions in Manila are warm and humid but manageable with an early start.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A solid Manila half marathon at SM MOA. 19 September 2026. [1]
